params.name: given
params.note: what the game gives with its event: the lines taken, the cells dropped

groups.name: any
above: every script passes on: the game answers some of its signals with an event at once (SIG_CLEAR: taken, SIG_LOCK: full)

scripts.name: flashing
scripts.note: the full lines flash a while; nothing falls

scripts.name: clearing
scripts.note: the game takes them away and tells what it took (taken): that goes on from here

lines.cond: lines < level * LINES_PER_LEVEL or level >= TOP_LEVEL

above: The game itself as an actor: its phase (what moves now: PH_*), the score, the lines, the level and how fast the
pieces fall, worked out here, and the waits of the game. The game tells it: moved and turned (the piece did),
landed (a piece lies on something: it locks after a while), lifted (it moved off), full (lines are full: they
flash a while), taken with given set (the lines it took away at once), dropped with given set (cells a piece was
dropped by hand), topped (no room). Its signals: SIG_NUMBERS the numbers changed, SIG_OVER the game is over, SIG_LOCK
the piece is locked, SIG_CLEAR the full lines go, SIG_NEW a new game (the game empties the well).
The fall of the piece: a row every game_var.fall ms, every SOFT_DROP_MS while down is held (game_var.soft); the game
moves the piece down and starts it anew (hurry) as a piece comes or down is pressed.

dialogs.name: pause
dialogs.text:
dialog pause
roles play PLAY
game PLAY
style menu
pause
    say game "PAUSED  Score {score}  Lines {lines}"
choose play
    "Continue" -> resume
    "Music" control SLIDER game_var.music_volume
    "Effects" control SLIDER game_var.effects_volume
    "New game" -> restart
label resume
    end
label restart
    tell play restart
    end
